starters.name: admin_invite
starters.description: Invite a new administrator to the system. Contains an activation link + temporary password.

tokens.name: WebsiteTitle
tokens.description: Human-readable name of the product or instance.

tokens.name: Username
tokens.description: Username of the invited administrator.

tokens.name: ActivationLink
tokens.description: Absolute URL the invitee clicks to activate the account and set a password.

tokens.name: TempPassword
tokens.description: Short-lived password the user can sign in with until they change it.

tokens.name: ExpiresIn
tokens.description: Human-readable duration before the activation link expires.
